change_request.backout_plan: Delete the CORE-RTR01 VM and the LAB-CORE switch.
change_request.close_notes: Core network built and tested. All VLANs reach their gateways, Guest is isolated from internal networks but has internet, RDP to the router works only from Management, and drops are logged. No issues.
change_request.description: Create the LAB-CORE virtual switch and build CORE-RTR01 to route four VLANs (Servers, Workstations, Management, Guest), following docs/traffic-policy.md and the IPAM sheet.
change_request.implementation_plan: 1. Create LAB-CORE private switch. 2. Build CORE-RTR01 (Server 2025) with 4 VLAN adapters + 1 outside. 3. Give each adapter its .1 address. 4. Turn on routing and NAT. 5. Add firewall rules from the traffic policy.
change_request.justification: The lab needs separate networks so each group only reaches what it needs. Everything later in the project depends on this.
change_request.risk_impact_analysis: Low. Everything is inside Hyper-V and doesn't touch the home network.
change_request.test_plan: Ping each gateway from a test VM, check routing between VLANs, and confirm traffic blocked by the policy is actually blocked.
